description:
The datagen manifest validation (_validate_manifest_if_present in runner.py)
only checks that its own recorded files exist with correct sizes. It has no
concept of "unexpected entries" in the datagen directory. When stale Iceberg
table directories (customer/, lineitem/) coexist with valid manifest-tracked
files (customer.tbl.1.zst), validation passes but loading breaks.

Fix: add narrow collision detection that invalidates reuse when an untracked
directory shares a table name. This triggers regeneration (or raises under
no_regenerate), preventing users from ever reaching the broken load state.

Also add an entry type guard: if a manifest entry resolves to a directory but
is not marked is_directory, treat as invalid (catches corrupted state).

DataFrame paths also need narrow protection: if file-based loading encounters
a directory path, prefer colocated manifest file entries when available;
otherwise raise a clear error instead of surfacing IsADirectoryError.
